Earth's population has slowly declined as much of its people are sent to their deaths in the war with the Klingons. All of the human's resources have been spent on the war and the cities of Earth have fallen into disrepair. Even so, most humans are not willing to leave the one place they call home.

systems.summary: Annexed Orion trade world with a slave economy.

brokenMirror.description: The humans quickly annexed the planet Orion to take full advantage of the already-existing slave trade here. Though Orions are not good laborers, they do make fine administrators and secretaries. Over 80% of the beauracratic system on Earth is operated by Orion slaves. Because of their importance, Orions live a privileged life with many benefits over other slaves such as the Lysians.
